name: A Happiness Story
source:
"A Happiness Story" is a heart-driven time travel story featuring a unique mix of mystery and fantasy.

Play as the weirdly unnamed 18-years-old hero as he struggles to find a reason to keep living  before a certain encounter changes everything. Discover the memories you've lost a summer ago and fight against a mysterious group that wants you dead. 

Solve the mysteries before it's too late and reclaim your rightful place not just as a human worthy of living but as a GOD.

This game is tied to all previous games by [url=/p14731]Fouzi[/url] but can be played on its own.

[Edited from [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/a-happiness-story]Itch.io[/url]]
